Name: Default WSUS client baseline
Description: Windows Update policy values that point clients at WSUS and control when updates install and reboot. Edit to match your environment. Tokens: {WsusServerUrl} = the WSUS server you connected to (or -WsusServerUrl); {TargetGroup} = the WSUS group you targeted (or -TargetGroup). AllowedValues (optional) lets compliance accept any of several values; Value is what gets written.

Settings.Name: WUServer
Settings.Description: Intranet update service used for detection.

Settings.Name: TargetGroupEnabled
Settings.Description: Enable client-side targeting (WSUS Options > Computers must be set to 'Use Group Policy or registry settings').

Settings.Name: TargetGroup
Settings.Description: WSUS computer group this client reports into.

Settings.Name: DoNotConnectToWindowsUpdateInternetLocations
Settings.Description: Do not reach out to Microsoft Update on the internet.

Settings.Name: UseWUServer
Settings.Description: Use the WUServer value above instead of Microsoft Update.

Settings.Name: AUOptions
Settings.Description: 2 = notify, 3 = auto download + notify, 4 = auto download + schedule install. Compliant if 3 or 4; 4 is written.

Settings.Name: ScheduledInstallTime
Settings.Description: Hour of day (0-23) for scheduled installs.

Settings.Name: NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers
Settings.Description: Do not auto-restart while a user is logged on.

Settings.Name: DisableDualScan
Settings.Description: Do not let deferral policies cause scans against Windows Update.
